claim_text: Our emissions intensity has increased by approximately 3% from 0.53 tonnes of CO2e per ounce of gold in FY24 to 0.56 in FY25.
context_text:
[Table] GREENHOUSE GAS EMISSIONS INTENSITY FY2025 FY2024 FY2023
Emissions per Gold Produced (kg CO2-e/oz) 561.4 531.1 514.1.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: The table supports that emissions intensity increased, but the reported values imply an increase larger than approximately 3%, so the quantitative phrasing is not fully matched.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that emissions intensity increased by about 3%, from 0.53 tCO2e/oz in FY24 to 0.56 tCO2e/oz in FY25. The evidence provides emissions per gold produced values of 531.1 and 561.4 kg CO2-e/oz, which correspond to 0.5311 and 0.5614 tCO2e/oz, matching the claimed 0.53 and 0.56 (rounded). The change from 531.1 to 561.4 kg is an increase of 30.3 kg, which is about 5.7% (30.3/531.1), while the rounded figures 0.53 to 0.56 imply about 5.7% as well; describing this as “approximately 3%” is not numerically aligned with the provided values. However, the core direction and the FY24/FY25 intensity values are supported, and the increase is substantiated; the only mismatch is the stated percentage magnitude.
